versions.content: Size Indicator for dynamicArraySizeProfile set to VSA_LINEAR , VSA_SQUARE , or VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE If an Implementation- DataType is mapped to an ApplicationArrayDataType which has the attribute dynamicArraySizeProfile set to the value VSA_LINEAR , VSA_SQUARE or VSA_- FULLY_FLEXIBLE , the first ImplementationDataType . subElement shall be an integer large enough to hold the maximum number of valid elements of the variable size array (according to maxNumberOfElements ). This is the Size Indicator which holds the current number of valid elements of the variable size array.
